messages.subject: Marldale v Crayford - draft Particulars and Schedule of Loss
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Harriet,

Draft Particulars of Claim and the Schedule of Loss are with you for settling. Total pleaded at £1,364,700 (remedial £612k / lost profit £648.5k / overheads £104.2k), plus s.35A interest. Grateful for your mark-up, especially tightening the throughput plea and the loss-of-profit head.

Tom

messages.subject: RE: Marldale v Crayford - draft Particulars and Schedule of Loss
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Mark-up returned (tracked). I've strengthened the throughput plea (34% shortfall) and noted the like-for-like component replacements at para 11. Content with the heads of loss but flag to the client that loss of profit is the exposed head - I'd expect recovery nearer £450-520k there after credit for saved costs. We can take quantum in conference once the expert reports.

Harriet Stanford
Eldon Chambers
